answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral and exposes correlated equivocation through shared timing, keys, or voting patterns: when k identities coordinate, penalties scale as O(k^2), exhausting escrow faster than linear gains. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier applies to capital loss across the swarm, while asymmetric depreciation limits recovery. An oasis, kernel, or plume cannot conceal this common liability.
